author: Second Wind
description:
You've gotta treat a one-shot differently than a campaign. The pacing, the content, the payoffs. Everything needs to be on a tighter timetable but still be satisfying. Sohpia Ricciardi from Rolling with Difficulty and Jesse Galena from Adventure Is Nigh! talk about what DMs can do to have a successful one-shot from prep to player interactions to execution.

If you dig watching us check out indies, considering supporting us over at Patreon -- https://www.patreon.com/SecondWindGroup

title: How to Run a Successful One-Shot w/ Sophia Ricciardi from Rolling with Difficulty | RPG Help Desk
